<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <title>Smart Grid System</title>

    <style>
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            margin: 0;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;

            background:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 140, 190, 0.15), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.20)),
                linear-gradient(to bottom, #08a5d0 0%, #6bc6e5 45%, #8fc9d8 65%, #071f05 65%, #071f05 100%);

            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Top navigation */
        .navbar {
            height: 55px;
            background: #004b82;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 25px;
            color: white;
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .nav-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .nav-buttons a {
            background: white;
            color: #004b82;
            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 7px 15px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        /* Main section */
        .main-container {
            min-height: calc(100vh - 55px);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: flex-start;
            padding: 25px 15px;
        }

        /* Input card */
        .input-card {
            width: 600px;
            max-width: 95%;
            background: rgba(240, 248, 252, 0.94);
            padding: 18px 25px 22px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        }

        .input-card h1 {
            text-align: center;
            color: #07527f;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin: 5px 0 18px;
        }

        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 9px;
        }

        .form-group label {
            display: block;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #222;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }

        .form-group input {
            width: 100%;
            height: 29px;
            border: 1px solid #d2d2d2;
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: 5px 8px;
            background: white;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .form-group input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #0066a6;
        }

        .predict-button {
            width: 100%;
            height: 34px;
            margin-top: 5px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 3px;
            background: #005a9c;
            color: white;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .predict-button:hover {
            background: #004478;
        }

        .result {
            margin-top: 18px;
            padding: 12px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 4px;
            text-align: center;
            color: #07527f;
        }

        @media (max-width: 650px) {
            .navbar {
                padding: 0 10px;
            }

            .logo {
                font-size: 15px;
            }

            .nav-buttons a {

    </style>
</head>

<body>

    <!-- Navigation -->
    <div class="navbar">

        <div class="logo">
            Smart Grid System
        </div>

        <div class="nav-buttons">
            <a href="/prediction">Load Balancer</a>
            <a href="#">Energy Insights</a>
            <a href="/logout">Log Out</a>
        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- Main content -->
    <div class="main-container">

        <div class="input-card">

            <h1>Welcome, {{ session.get("user_name", "User") }}</h1>

            <form method="POST" action="/prediction">

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Voltage (V):</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="voltage"
                        placeholder="Enter voltage"
                        required>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Current (A):</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="current"
                        placeholder="Enter current"
                        required>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Reactive Power (kVAR):</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="reactive_power"
                        placeholder="Enter reactive power"
                        required>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Power Factor:</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="power_factor"
                        placeholder="Enter power factor"
                        required>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Solar Panel (Watt rating, e.g. 10W):</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="solar_power"
                        placeholder="Enter solar panel rating">
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Wind Turbine (Watt rating, e.g. 400W):</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="wind_power"
                        placeholder="Enter wind turbine rating">
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Wind Turbine Radius (meters, optional):</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="wind_radius"
                        placeholder="Enter turbine radius">
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Your Location (Latitude):</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="latitude"
                        placeholder="Enter latitude">
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Your Location (Longitude):</label>
                    <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        name="longitude"
                        placeholder="Enter longitude">
                </div>

                <!-- Temporary fields required by our current app.py -->
                <input type="hidden" name="temperature" value="30">
                <input type="hidden" name="humidity" value="60">

                <button type="submit" class="predict-button">
                    Predict
                </button>

            </form>


            {% if result is not none %}

            <div class="result">

                <strong>Predicted Load:</strong>
                {{ result }} kW

            </div>

            {% endif %}

        </div>

    </div>

</body>
</html>
